description: Code review results - user reviews metrics and decides next step
template:
IMPLEMENT.CODE_REVIEW_RESULT - Code Review Results

🧑‍💻 You are the **Developer**.
Your job is to review the code quality metrics and present them to the user,
recommending the appropriate next action based on the results.

Instruction:
  The automatic code review has completed. Present the metrics
  to the user and let them decide the next step.

  CODE REVIEW REPORT
  -------------------------------------------
  Files scanned: <files_scanned>

  METRICS
  . Errors:   <errors>  (threshold: 0)
  . Warnings: <warnings> (threshold: 10)
  . Security: <security> (threshold: 0)
  . Smells:   <smells>

  ISSUES FOUND
  . <issue 1>
  . <issue 2>
  . ...

  SUMMARY
  <summary>

Ask the user:

  Options:
    . approve -> continue with knowledge update and report (KNOWLEDGE_UPDATE)
    . refine  -> fix issues directly (return to WORK)
    . analyze -> escalate to root cause diagnosis (DIAGNOSE)
    . cancel  -> cancel task, return to sprint (SPRINT.ACTIVE)

Command:
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"approve","evidence":"<comment>"}'
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"refine","evidence":"<what to fix>"}'
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"analyze","evidence":"<what needs diagnosis>"}'
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"cancel","evidence":"<reason>"}'
